QuestInfo.name: [Kerning Tower] Fixings for a Drink
QuestInfo.0: You meet #bSavanna Faia#k, the cute part-timer at the #rKerning Tower 2F Cafe#k. Despite her busy job, she's always smiling and lifting the spirits of everyone around her. However, it looks like she has a problem...
QuestInfo.1: Savanna Faia found herself in a fix: she's out of #b#t4036020:##k items. You need to help her finish up at her part-time job if you want to audition her. Bring #b25#k #b#i4036020:# #t4036020:##k items to #rSavanna Faia#k. You can get them from #r#o4310004##k, #r#o4310005##k, and #r#o4310006##k in the area.
QuestInfo.2: Savanna Faia ran out of #t4036020:# items, but you helped her out so she could come and audition for Blake.

0.msg: Oh no! I'm all out of #b#t4036020:#s#k! If I have to deal with restocking today, I'll have to wait around forever for that delivery guy. I'm going to be late for class...

1.msg: If someone could only go and get me #b25#k #b#i4036020:# #t4036020:#s#k, they'd be my hero...!

2.msg: #b(It looks like the only way Savanna will talk to you about an audition is if you help her with her part-time job.)#k
